sections.heading: Spaceflight urinary risks
sections.text: Alterations in hydration state (relative dehydration), spaceflight-induced changes in urine biochemistry (urine supersaturation), microgravity-induced alterations in fluid dynamics and position of abdominal structures, and changes in bone metabolism (increased calcium excretion) during exposure to microgravity may all contribute to the increased risk of urinary health issues.
